description: Convert one or more files on this computer to another format and save the results locally. Each result is written next to its input file (or into output_dir) as <input name>.<to>; conversions with several results (for example one PNG per PDF page) are saved as <input name>-1.<to>, <input name>-2.<to>, ... Existing files are never replaced unless overwrite is true. Returns the saved paths and sizes, credits used, notes and, on failure, an error code with an explanation. timeout_seconds covers the whole call: files that could not start in time come back as not_started (nothing uploaded, no credits). Relative paths are resolved against the server's working directory; prefer absolute paths.

input_path.description: Path of the file to convert. Use this or input_paths.

input_paths.description: Several files to convert to the same format (up to 50).

options.description: Conversion settings, for example {"quality": 80} or {"video_codec": "x264", "crf": 23}. Call list_formats with from and to to see the options of a pair. Leave out for automatic settings.

output_dir.description: Directory for the results. Created if missing. Default: the directory of each input file.

overwrite.description: Replace existing files with the same name. Default false.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result, in seconds (default 600). If the conversion is still running then, the answer contains the conversion id for get_conversion.

to.description: Target format as a file extension, for example mp4, pdf, png, docx, mp3.

name: convert_file
title: Convert local files
